Home

University recognised for global impact in sustainability
The University of Aberdeen has been recognised among the world's leading universities for environmental impact, governance and social impact in the QS Sustainability Rankings 2027.

Aberdeen Global Scholarship
We are offering international students scholarships of £6,000 (per year) for eligible undergraduate programmes and £8,000 for eligible master's programmes.

Together we Break Boundaries
Discover how our researchers are breaking boundaries – going beyond borders and disciplines to create impact for over 525 years
UK Top 30

28th in the UK in The Times & Sunday Times Good University Guide 2027 and the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027

Satisfaction

3rd in Scotland for overall satisfaction in The National Student Survey 2026

Sustainability

17th in the UK in the Times Higher Education Sustainability Impact Ratings 2026

Find a Degree

Degree Search
Undergraduate

At the University of Aberdeen we offer a flexible and individual approach to your studies.
Postgraduate Taught

A wide variety of research-led programmes taught by leaders in the field.
Postgraduate Research

Our research crosses disciplines to find solutions to the world's greatest challenges.
Online Learning

Fit your learning around your location, work and personal commitments.

Leading the transition in Europe's Energy capital

We spark urgent conversations with experts from around the world and work across borders and disciplines to accelerate the transition to a better energy future.

Explore energy transition

News

Karajarri cultural treasures returned in ceremony at the University

Traditional shields, digging sticks and sacred men's objects will be returned to the Karajarri People of the Kimberley Region in Western Australia.

Find out more

University of Aberdeen secures £200,000 to fund STEM scholarships for women from Uzbekistan

Funded places for five women from Uzbekistan will be available at the University of Aberdeen after a successful bid to secure £200,000 funding from a British Council programme that helps women access postgraduate STEM education at UK universities.

Find out more

  • University and Students' Union renew commitment to tackling gender-based violence

  • University recognised for global impact in sustainability

  • University strengthens global standing as Interdisciplinary Institute retains Scotland's top ranking

  • Turnitin disabled - alternative submission arrangements to follow

  • Evening with Rear Admiral (Ret'd) Chris Hockley
More News

Our History

Since our foundation in 1495, the University of Aberdeen has celebrated many incredible milestones.
